title: slots_carried: which records count, and how far a record-valued field is followed
null_rule: null means NOT_RECORDED. No field has a default; *_provenance says who recorded each value. Provenance values as in M01_SCHEMA.json.

reader_id.note: pseudonym or [readings folder] folder name; never reader_label

instruction_sha256.note: sha256 of conditions/M02_Dn.md; null for D0

arm.note: FILED = a reading taken before M02 existed

recalled_prior.note: sequential arm: did the reader say they recalled or reused the earlier answer

traversal_rule.note: a nested-field rule, recorded apart from scope_rule

rule_quote.note: verbatim, where the reader stated a rule

ambiguity_stated.note: true only where the reader's text says so; null otherwise

unmatched_names.note: names in the reader's slots_carried that no catalog record carries: reported, never dropped

record_id.note: local id from the catalog, not a source identifier

depth.note: 0 = the term's own record; a record built beside it is also 0; a wrapper is +1; a nested record is +1 from its holder

nested_field_refs.note: field -> record_id of the record it holds

counted.note: from the reader's slots_carried: all / some / none of this record's own fields named. NOT_COUNTED is not 'excluded'

opened.note: for a NESTED_RECORD: did the reader list its fields
